response.sql:
SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count
FROM advancedbehavior AS a
JOIN transactionrecord AS t
  ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
ORDER BY t.ordertypedist;

assumptions.assumption: “High similarity” includes records with patsim equal to the 0.439 cutoff.
